title: Probabilistic sampler for golden-set enrichment and auto-isolation
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Problem: Current canary and shadowing pipelines rely on static golden prompt subsets that create hotspots (over-sampling of a few templates) and brittle thresholds, which leads to noisy alerts or missed regressions. Goal: Introduce a probabilistic sampling layer that dynamically enriches the golden set coverage per-cohort, isolates suspect cohorts for targeted quarantine, and feeds weighted evidence into the existing scorecard gating and automatic rollback conductor. Success criteria: (1) improved prompt coverage across cohorts (measured by unique prompt-to-cohort coverage increase >= 35%), (2) reduction in false-positive gating alerts by 40% in staged rollouts, (3) graceful auto-isolation that reduces blast radius while preserving signal for regressions. Scope: implement sampling policy engine, integration hooks into shadow/canary router, enrichment pipeline for golden reservoirs, quarantine API for cohort isolation, and telemetry/dashboarding for weighted-evidence scorecards.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Kickoff: Reviewed proposal with PM (Sofia Patel) and SRE. Agreed on cohort definition: customer_id, route_id, and input-length-bucket. Decided to prioritize customer-facing cohorts for initial rollout.

2026-02-18 - Spike results: Prototype sampler reduced repeated-template probability by 58% on production-like trace. Memory overhead for enrichment buffer acceptable (~200MB per 100k sampled requests).
2026-02-23 - Design feedback: Design asked to expose sampled-example preview via Console for canary owners. Added task to provide a 'golden-sample view' in Console UX backlog.
2026-02-27 - Perf note: Runtime microbench indicates ~1.8ms median added latency when sampler runs inline; exploring async sampling path to keep tail latency unaffected.

2026-03-01 - Next steps: Land infra changes (kafka topic for enriched samples), implement quarantine API, wire weighted evidence into eval scorecard service, and add dashboard panels for sample coverage and gating precision.
Reviewer: Priya Nair (Applied ML) requested unit tests around weighted evidence decay and an integration test simulating a small regression to validate quarantine does not suppress true positives.
